summary: Tested TTS Meditation 4-Part Audio Generation feature. All backend API tests pass (12/12). Frontend meditation flow works correctly with parallel audio loading and chained playback.

Error handling is proper: part=5 returns 400, nonexistent meditation returns 404
Scripts include 'Allow yourself to deepen' transitions between parts as requested
